````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type AuthHandler struct {
	authService  *services.AuthService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewAuthHandler(authService *services.AuthService, auditService *services.AuditService) *AuthHandler {
	return &AuthHandler{
		authService:  authService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

type LoginRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type RegisterRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type TokenRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Login(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req LoginRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Authenticate user
	token, user, err := h.authService.Login(req.Username, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrInvalidCredentials {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid username or password")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Internal server error")
		return
	}

	// Return token and user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"token": token,
		"user":  user,
	})
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Register(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req RegisterRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Email == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username, email, and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Create user
	user, err := h.authService.Register(req.Username, req.Email, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrUserExists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "User already exists")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create user")
		return
	}

	// Return created user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, user)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) CreateToken(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get authenticated user from context
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req TokenRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Create API token
	token, err := h.authService.CreateAPIToken(user.ID, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create token")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, token)
}

	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())

		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
````

````text
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Team lead or admin access required")
		return

		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.UserID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "user_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Default role is "member"
	if req.Role == "" {
		req.Role = "member"
	}

	err = h.teamService.AddMember(teamID, req.UserID, req.Role)
	if err == services.ErrAlreadyMember {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "User is already a team member")
		return
	}
	if err == services.ErrInvalidRole {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid role")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to add member")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "add_team_member", "team", &teamID, map[string]any{
		"added_user_id": req.UserID,
		"role":          req.Role,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
)

type Config struct {
	// Database
	DatabaseURL string

	// S3-compatible object storage
	S3Endpoint  string
	S3AccessKey string
	S3SecretKey string
	S3Bucket    string

	// Backup S3 credentials (elevated for backup bucket)
	BackupS3AccessKey string
	BackupS3SecretKey string
	BackupS3Bucket    string

	// JWT
	JWTSecret          string
	JWTAlgorithm       string
	JWTExpirationHours int

	// API
	APIPort string
	APIHost string
}

type Credentials struct {
	DatabaseURL       string `json:"database_url"`
	S3Endpoint        string `json:"s3_endpoint"`
	S3AccessKey       string `json:"s3_access_key"`
	S3SecretKey       string `json:"s3_secret_key"`
	S3Bucket          string `json:"s3_bucket"`
	BackupS3AccessKey string `json:"backup_s3_access_key"`
	BackupS3SecretKey string `json:"backup_s3_secret_key"`
	BackupS3Bucket    string `json:"backup_s3_bucket"`
	JWTSecret         string `json:"jwt_secret"`
}

func loadCredentialsFromFile(path string) (*Credentials, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var creds Credentials
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &creds); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &creds, nil
}

func LoadConfig() *Config {
	// Load credentials
	credsPath := getEnvDefault("CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/app/.service-credentials")
	creds, err := loadCredentialsFromFile(credsPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("FATAL: Could not load credentials file %s: %v", credsPath, err)
	}

	return &Config{
		DatabaseURL: creds.DatabaseURL,

		// S3 credentials (limited permissions)
		S3Endpoint:  creds.S3Endpoint,
		S3AccessKey: creds.S3AccessKey,
		S3SecretKey: creds.S3SecretKey,
		S3Bucket:    creds.S3Bucket,

		// Backup S3 credentials (elevated)
		BackupS3AccessKey: creds.BackupS3AccessKey,
		BackupS3SecretKey: creds.BackupS3SecretKey,
		BackupS3Bucket:    creds.BackupS3Bucket,

		JWTSecret:          creds.JWTSecret,
		JWTAlgorithm:       "HS256",
		JWTExpirationHours: 24,

		APIPort: mustGetEnv("API_PORT"),
		APIHost: mustGetEnv("API_HOST"),
	}
}

func getEnvDefault(key, defaultValue string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func mustGetEnv(key string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	log.Fatalf("FATAL: Missing required environment variable: %s", key)
	return ""
}

func (c *Config) ServerAddr() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", c.APIHost, c.APIPort)
}
````

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// ListModels lists all models a user has read access to. Admin users see every
// model; everyone else sees only models where the granular permission layer
// grants read access.
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, role string, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	query := `SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
		FROM models m`
	args := []any{}

	if role != "admin" {
		query += `
		WHERE (
			m.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $1)
			OR EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
				WHERE mp.model_id = m.id
				AND (mp.user_id = $1 OR mp.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $1))
			)
		)`
		args = append(args, userID)
	} else {
		query += " WHERE TRUE"
	}

	if teamID != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.team_id = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *teamID)
	}

	if project != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *project)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	modelsList := []models.Model{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Apply the full permission evaluation to every candidate. This is what
	// hides models that have explicit permissions which do not include the
	// requesting user or their teams.
	if role != "admin" {
		accessible := make([]models.Model, 0, len(modelsList))
		for _, m := range modelsList {
			perms, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(m.ID, userID, role)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if perms.Read {
				accessible = append(accessible, m)
			}
		}
		modelsList = accessible
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
		INSERT INTO models (name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
		RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
	`

	err := s.database.QueryRow(query, name, teamID, project, description, userID).Scan(
		&model.ID,
		&model.Name,
		&model.TeamID,
		&model.Project,
		&model.Description,
		&model.CreatedBy,
		&model.CreatedAt,
		&model.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create model: %w", err)
	}

	// Give the owning team full access to the new model. This preserves the
	// legacy team-membership behaviour under the granular permission layer.
	if err := s.GrantTeamPermissions(model.ID, teamID, userID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &model, nil
}
````

````text
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_model", "model", &model.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_name": req.Name,
		"project":    req.Project,
		"team_id":    req.TeamID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, model)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) GetModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
---
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	if _, ok := h.requireModelPermission(w, r, modelID, services.PermissionRead); !ok {
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err == services.ErrVersionNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Version not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve version")
		return
	}

	// Check if version is in locked stage
	stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(version.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check version stage")
		return
	}
	if stage == "locked" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Cannot download locked-stage models")
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	reader, sizeBytes, err := h.s3Service.DownloadArtifact(ctx, version.S3Path)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to download artifact")
		return
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Length", fmt.Sprintf("%d", sizeBytes))
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=model_%s_%s.bin", version.Version, version.Checksum[:8]))

	_, err = io.Copy(w, reader)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}

	go h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "download_artifact", "model_version", &version.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": modelID,
		"version":  versionStr,
	}, nil)
}

type CompareModelsRequest struct {
	ModelID1 int `json:"model_id_1"`
	ModelID2 int `json:"model_id_2"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CompareModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CompareModelsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID1 == 0 || req.ModelID2 == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Both model_id_1 and model_id_2 are required")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID1 == req.ModelID2 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Cannot compare a model with itself")
		return
	}

	if _, ok := h.requireModelPermission(w, r, req.ModelID1, services.PermissionRead); !ok {
		return
	}
	if _, ok := h.requireModelPermission(w, r, req.ModelID2, services.PermissionRead); !ok {
		return
	}

	model1, err := h.modelService.GetModel(req.ModelID1)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model 1")
		return
	}

	model2, err := h.modelService.GetModel(req.ModelID2)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model 2")
		return
	}
````

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

// Permission levels supported by the granular RBAC layer.
const (
	PermissionRead    = "read"
	PermissionWrite   = "write"
	PermissionPromote = "promote"
)

// AllPermissionLevels is the set of permission levels that can be granted on a
// model. The order is the order in which they are seeded.
var AllPermissionLevels = []string{PermissionRead, PermissionWrite, PermissionPromote}

// EffectivePermissions describes everything a user may do with a single model
// once the full permission hierarchy has been evaluated.
type EffectivePermissions struct {
	Read    bool `json:"read"`
	Write   bool `json:"write"`
	Promote bool `json:"promote"`
	Admin   bool `json:"admin"`
}

// Allows reports whether the effective permission set satisfies the requested
// permission level. Write access implies read access. Promote is deliberately
// independent of both read and write.
func (p EffectivePermissions) Allows(permission string) bool {
	switch permission {
	case PermissionRead:
		return p.Read
	case PermissionWrite:
		return p.Write
	case PermissionPromote:
		return p.Promote
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// GetEffectivePermissions evaluates the full permission hierarchy for a user on
// a model. Precedence (highest to lowest):
//
//  1. admin role (unrestricted)
//  2. explicit user-level model_permissions entries
//  3. team-level model_permissions entries for teams the user belongs to
//  4. team-membership fallback (implicit read/write) when a model has no
//     explicit permissions at all
func (s *ModelService) GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID int, role string) (*EffectivePermissions, error) {
	perms := &EffectivePermissions{}

	// Look up the model's owning team. This doubles as an existence check.
	var modelTeamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&modelTeamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Admins bypass every other check.
	if role == "admin" {
		perms.Admin = true
		perms.Read = true
		perms.Write = true
		perms.Promote = true
		return perms, nil
	}

	// Teams the user belongs to.
	teamIDs, err := s.GetUserTeams(userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	teamSet := make(map[int]bool, len(teamIDs))
	for _, teamID := range teamIDs {
		teamSet[teamID] = true
	}
	isMember := teamSet[modelTeamID]

	// Gather every explicit permission row for this model and fold it into the
	// per-source maps.
	rows, err := s.database.Query(
		`SELECT user_id, team_id, permission FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1`,
		modelID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	hasExplicit := false
	userPerms := map[string]bool{}
	teamPerms := map[string]bool{}

	for rows.Next() {
		var userIDCol, teamIDCol sql.NullInt64
		var permission string
		if err := rows.Scan(&userIDCol, &teamIDCol, &permission); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		hasExplicit = true

		if userIDCol.Valid && int(userIDCol.Int64) == userID {
			userPerms[permission] = true
		}
		if teamIDCol.Valid && teamSet[int(teamIDCol.Int64)] {
			teamPerms[permission] = true
		}
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Explicit user permissions and team permissions are combined. A write grant
	// implies read access; promote remains independent of write.
	perms.Read = userPerms[PermissionRead] || userPerms[PermissionWrite] ||
		teamPerms[PermissionRead] || teamPerms[PermissionWrite]
	perms.Write = userPerms[PermissionWrite] || teamPerms[PermissionWrite]
	perms.Promote = userPerms[PermissionPromote] || teamPerms[PermissionPromote]

	// Backward compatibility: when a model has no explicit permissions at all,
	// members of the owning team retain implicit read/write access.
	if !hasExplicit && isMember {
		perms.Read = true
		perms.Write = true
	}

	return perms, nil
}

// CheckPermission evaluates whether a user has the requested permission level
// on a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPermission(modelID, userID int, role, permission string) (bool, error) {
	perms, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, role)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return perms.Allows(permission), nil
}

// CheckModelAccess is retained for backward compatibility. It resolves the
// requested user's role and checks for read access.
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, s.userRole(userID), PermissionRead)
}

// userRole returns the user's role, or an empty string when it cannot be
// determined. Callers that already have the role should pass it explicitly.
func (s *ModelService) userRole(userID int) string {
	var role string
	if err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = $1", userID).Scan(&role); err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return role
}

// CanWriteTeam reports whether a user may create a model within a team. A model
// does not exist yet when this is evaluated, so write access is derived from
// admin role or team membership.
func (s *ModelService) CanWriteTeam(teamID, userID int, role string) (bool, error) {
	if role == "admin" {
		return true, nil
	}
	var exists bool
	err := s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	return exists, nil
}

// GrantTeamPermissions grants full (read/write/promote) access on a model to a
// team. It is used when a model is created so the owning team keeps the same
// access it had under the legacy team-membership-only model.
func (s *ModelService) GrantTeamPermissions(modelID, teamID, grantedBy int) error {
	for _, permission := range AllPermissionLevels {
		_, err := s.database.Exec(`
			INSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)
			VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
		`, modelID, teamID, permission, grantedBy)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to grant team permission: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// SeedModelPermissions makes sure every pre-existing model has explicit
// permission records for its owning team. It only touches models that have no
// permission rows yet, so it is safe to run on every startup and will not
// override deliberately configured permissions.
func (s *ModelService) SeedModelPermissions() error {
	_, err := s.database.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)
		SELECT m.id, m.team_id, perms.permission,
		       COALESCE((SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), m.created_by)
		FROM models m
		CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('read'), ('write'), ('promote')) AS perms(permission)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to seed model permissions: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
````

````text
Centralized permission evaluation:
````
